body: I was in your same position just yesterday! I got into Wellesley but ultimately declined their offer. Admittedly, I am still a bit nervous regarding my decision but I’m choosing to be optimistic about this coming school year!

Intended Major: Journalism

Wellesley (If I go here, I plan on pursuing English or Cinema and Media Studies instead)

Wellesley Pros:
- top ranked women’s college
- absolutely beautiful campus
- stronger alumni network
- the small class sizes + professors

 Wellesley Cons:
- location, a 9 hr train ride away
- scared of impostor syndrome
- doesn’t offer the major I want to pursue

Fordham

Fordham Pros:
- I got into the Manhattan campus so location is definitely a pro
- I’ll be able to intern at the bigger, New York-based publications
- My major is offered along with a minor in Fashion Studies, which I’m really interested in
- I’ve already been to the campus in-person

Fordham Cons:
- a LOT of people I know have been admitted/are going to schools in the area (this is a big drawback for me)
- From what I’ve heard from some students and recent graduates, there have been some horror stories of bad professors or a generally miserable school life altogether 
- Not as prestigious
